Name: Grass Bomb
Author: kinivy
Description:
[b][size=4][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/vgHnXgGX/description.png[/img][/url][/size][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tired of placing grass manually with grass starters? Here's a more explosive option. :) [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Adds a new type of bomb, the Grass Bomb! It is pretty simple. It explodes into a field of grass. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Use it to fill your fields or to prank your friends by filling their houses. Up to you!
[/color]
Now including both normal and blue grass bombs.

[size=4][b][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://postimg.cc/f3Kt3xGs][img]https://i.postimg.cc/f3Kt3xGs/grasssb2-(1).gif[/img]

[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/R6VtG6vd/how-to-obtain.png[/img][/url][/color][/b][/size]
[spoiler][b]Grass Bomb[/b]
Recipe earned at Farming Level 5.
100 Fiber & 1 Coal.
Buy from Dwarf shop. Default 2100

[b]Blue Grass Bomb[/b]
Recipe bought from Qi for 80 gems.
200 Fiber, 100 Moss, 10 Mystic Syrup, 1 Coal
Also buy from Qi for 10 gems per bomb.

Please give feedback on these recipes. I'm not sure what people would want.[/spoiler]
[b][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/FdsSGdhx/configuration.png[/img][/url][/b]

BombPrice: Changes buy price. Default 2100.
BombRadius: Sets radius of explosion, default 2. (You can raise this high for fun results! Beware, high radius may cause lag.)
BlueBombGemPrice: Buy price from Mr Qi. Default 10.
BlueBombRecipeGemPrice: Cost of Blue Bomb recipe. Default 80.
